HTML tag names are case-insensitive: an uppercase void element must not swallow the content that follows it

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<html><head><META HTTP-EQUIV=\"Content-Type\" CONTENT=\"text/html; charset=us-ascii\"></head><body><p>Signature placeholder</p></body></html>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
